decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The conversion of the house to four flats, due to the excessive number of flats and the substandard internal layout, is an unacceptable overdevelopment of the site. The conversion has resulted in cramped living accommodation, has failed to provide adequate private amenity space, and has failed to provide at least one family sized unit, resulting in harm to the living conditions of the occupants, contrary to policy ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.3.4 (Conversions of Houses to Flats), H.4.1 (Housing Standards and Guidelines) of the Council's adopted Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 2 - The conversion fails to meet the Council's maximum parking standards, in a busy Controlled Parking Zone, and is therefore likely to result in conditions prejudicial to the free flow and safe movement of motorists and pedestrians in the area, contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) of the Council's adopted Unitary Development Plan.
description: Continued use of house into four self contained flats
